version.approval_notes: No build step and no minified first-party code: the package is the extension/ folder with the manifest adapted by tools/build.js. vendor/browser-polyfill.min.js is webextension-polyfill 0.12.0, unmodified, from npm. To test, the extension needs a Webex meeting joined in the browser (web.webex.com); test/scrape.test.html runs the chat reader against synthetic Webex markup.

summary.en-US: Export a Webex meeting chat (Everyone and direct chats, with markdown, replies and quotes) to one Excel sheet or JSON.

description.en-US:
Save the full chat of a Webex meeting you joined in the browser, in one click.

• Everyone and every direct (private) chat, in one Excel sheet or one JSON file
• Formatting kept as markdown: bold, italics, links, lists, headings, quotes and code blocks with their language
• Replies linked to the message that started the thread; quotes linked to the message they quote
• Reactions and system lines kept
• Your own messages are shown with your name from the participants list instead of "You"; you can override it
• Loads the whole history before exporting
• Asks where to save the file
• Optional reminder (off by default): if you close the meeting tab before exporting, it offers to export the chat it saw. It watches the chat during the meeting, so it can make Webex slower.
• Small files: compressed Excel and compact JSON

Everything stays on your computer: the extension collects nothing, sends nothing, and only runs on webex.com.

Open source (MIT). Not affiliated with Cisco or Webex.
